entities.summary: Colonel Eugene Kobylinsky was a Russian military officer who served as the commander of the special detachment at Tsarskoe Selo and Tobolsk in 1917–18, where he oversaw the imprisonment of former Russian Emperor Nicholas II, who abdicated his throne after the February Revolution of 1917.
